description: Add a dollar-based (account/deposit currency) SL/TP mode to SmcFvgBot.cs alongside the existing pip/broker path. Introduce an SL Mode selector (Pips|Dollar) and expand TP Mode to (Pips|RRR|Dollar). In Dollar mode the bot attaches NO broker stop/target for that dimension and instead monitors each of its OWN open positions individually on every tick, closing a position when its net P&L crosses the configured dollar threshold. Pip/RRR-with-pips behavior must be reproduced EXACTLY (purely additive). All SL x TP combinations allowed. Single-file change; C# cannot be compiled in this sandbox (no cAlgo.API assemblies) - verify by static reasoning only.
steps: Add a new namespace-scope enum `RiskUnit { Pips, Dollar }` near the other enums (FvgSource/EntryMode/EntryFib/TpMode) with a comment explaining Pips = broker stop, Dollar = monitored net-P&L threshold in account/deposit currency.

Extend the existing `TpMode` enum from {Points, RRR} to {Pips, RRR, Dollar}. RECOMMENDED: rename `Points` -> `Pips` for wording consistency with the new SL parameter. If renamed, update ALL references (the [Parameter] on TakeProfitMode default, and the PlaceStrategyOrder comparison `TakeProfitMode == TpMode.RRR`, and any comment mentioning Points/TpMode.Points). Keep the enum at namespace scope.

In the Risk parameter group, add `[Parameter("SL Mode", DefaultValue = RiskUnit.Pips, Group = "Risk")] public RiskUnit SlMode { get; set; }` placed next to StopLossPips. Add `[Parameter("Stop Loss ($)", DefaultValue = 10, MinValue = 0, Group = "Risk")] public double StopLossDollars { get; set; }` (comment: account/deposit currency net P&L; used when SL Mode = Dollar). Add `[Parameter("Take Profit ($)", DefaultValue = 30, MinValue = 0, Group = "Risk")] public double TakeProfitDollars { get; set; }` (comment: used when TP Mode = Dollar). Keep existing StopLossPips/TakeProfitPips/Rrr parameters unchanged. Update the TakeProfitMode [Parameter] DefaultValue to TpMode.Pips (if renamed) so the current default fixed-pip behavior is preserved.

Rewrite the SL/TP pip computation inside PlaceStrategyOrder so broker SL and broker TP are computed INDEPENDENTLY and only for the pip-based portions: broker SL pips = (SlMode == RiskUnit.Pips ? StopLossPips : (double?)null); broker TP pips = (TpMode==Pips -> TakeProfitPips; TpMode==RRR AND SlMode==Pips -> Rrr*StopLossPips; otherwise [TpMode==Dollar, or TpMode==RRR with SlMode==Dollar] -> null). Keep the existing <=0 -> null mapping applied to whatever pip magnitude is chosen. This ensures mixed modes (e.g. dollar SL + pip/RRR-pip TP) still get their broker TP. Update the block comment to describe the new decision logic.

Add an `OnTick` override (protected override void OnTick()) that iterates a SNAPSHOT (e.g. Positions.Where(p => p.Label != null && p.Label.StartsWith(BotLabelPrefix)).ToList()) of THIS bot's own open positions. For each position, evaluate ONLY the dollar-monitored dimensions using CURRENT parameter values: (a) SL check active iff SlMode==RiskUnit.Dollar, condition: position.NetProfit <= -(StopLossDollars) -> close; (b) TP check active iff (TpMode==TpMode.Dollar) OR (TpMode==TpMode.RRR AND SlMode==RiskUnit.Dollar), target dollars = (TpMode==TpMode.Dollar ? TakeProfitDollars : Rrr * StopLossDollars), condition: position.NetProfit >= target -> close. Guard so a threshold of <=0 does not trigger an immediate close (skip the SL check if StopLossDollars<=0; skip the TP check if the computed target<=0). Close via the current cAlgo call (use position.Close(); note ClosePosition(position) as the alternative in a comment). Break out of per-position checks once closed to avoid double action. Iterating a materialized snapshot avoids mutation-during-iteration when closing.

Add clarifying comments: (1) that 'Dollar' means account/deposit currency (usually USD) via Position.NetProfit which already includes commission + swap; (2) that positions are monitored individually by label prefix; (3) that if a broker SL/TP is attached (pip dimension) the broker manages that dimension and OnTick only acts on dollar-monitored dimensions, so no double-close; (4) that global params are applied at tick time (settings don't change mid-run) rather than stored per-position, and document the acceptable edge case if the user changes inputs and restarts mid-position.

Do NOT change FVG detection, structure engine, entry logic, the concurrent-order cap, or the dashboard. The dashboard reads realized History and continues to work for dollar-closed trades (they still land in History).
acceptance_criteria: New enum RiskUnit { Pips, Dollar } exists at namespace scope; TpMode is { Pips, RRR, Dollar }.

Three new [Parameter] properties exist in Group "Risk": SlMode (RiskUnit, default Pips), StopLossDollars (double, default 10, MinValue 0), TakeProfitDollars (double, default 30, MinValue 0). Existing StopLossPips/TakeProfitPips/Rrr retained.

PlaceStrategyOrder passes broker SL pips only when SlMode==Pips (else null) and broker TP pips only for pip-based TP (TpMode==Pips, or TpMode==RRR with SlMode==Pips); passes null for TP when TpMode==Dollar or (TpMode==RRR and SlMode==Dollar). SL and TP computed independently so mixed modes work.

An OnTick override closes each own position (by label prefix) using Position.NetProfit: SL when NetProfit <= -StopLossDollars (only if SlMode==Dollar and StopLossDollars>0); TP when NetProfit >= target (only if TpMode==Dollar OR (TpMode==RRR and SlMode==Dollar), target>0), where target = TpMode==Dollar ? TakeProfitDollars : Rrr*StopLossDollars.
With SlMode==Pips and TpMode==Pips (or RRR), the produced order calls and SL/TP pip values are behaviorally identical to the pre-change code (purely additive), and OnTick performs no closes.
Only SmcFvgBot.cs is modified; no .pine files touched.
verification: Static self-review: re-read the modified SmcFvgBot.cs end-to-end and confirm C# validity by reasoning (no compiler in sandbox; cAlgo.API assemblies unavailable).

Confirm cAlgo API members used are correct/plausible and flag any uncertain ones for the user to confirm on compile: Position.NetProfit, Position.Label, Positions collection, Position.Close() vs ClosePosition(...), OnTick() override signature.
Trace the pip-only path (SlMode=Pips, TpMode=Pips and TpMode=RRR) and confirm slPips/tpPips match the original computation exactly.
git diff --stat confirms only SmcFvgBot.cs changed.
findings: Implemented entirely in SmcFvgBot.cs (only file changed; no .pine touched; git diff --stat confirms). Changes: (1) Added namespace-scope enum RiskUnit { Pips, Dollar } with doc comment. (2) Renamed TpMode.Points -> TpMode.Pips and added TpMode.Dollar; updated all references (TakeProfitMode DefaultValue, PlaceStrategyOrder comparisons, header/enum comments). (3) Added three Risk-group [Parameter]s: SlMode (RiskUnit, default Pips), StopLossDollars (double, default 10, MinValue 0), TakeProfitDollars (double, default 30, MinValue 0); existing StopLossPips/TakeProfitPips/Rrr retained; TakeProfitMode default set to TpMode.Pips. (4) Rewrote the SL/TP pip computation in PlaceStrategyOrder to compute broker SL and broker TP independently: broker SL pips only when SlMode==Pips (else null); broker TP pips = TakeProfitPips when TpMode==Pips, Rrr*StopLossPips when TpMode==RRR && SlMode==Pips, else null (dollar-monitored). Kept the existing <=0 -> null mapping. (5) Added OnTick() override that iterates a materialized snapshot (Positions.Where label prefix .ToList()) of the bot's own open positions and closes each via position.Close() when Position.NetProfit crosses the dollar threshold: SL when NetProfit <= -StopLossDollars (active iff SlMode==Dollar, skipped when StopLossDollars<=0); TP when NetProfit >= target (active iff TpMode==Dollar OR (TpMode==RRR && SlMode==Dollar), target = TpMode==Dollar ? TakeProfitDollars : Rrr*StopLossDollars, skipped when target<=0). Early-returns when no dollar dimension active, so pip-only runs perform no closes. Added clarifying comments (dollar = account/deposit currency incl. commission+swap; per-position monitoring by label; broker manages pip dimensions so no double-close; global params read live at tick time with documented restart edge case). VERIFICATION: static self-review only (no cAlgo.API assemblies in sandbox; C# not compilable here). Traced pip-only path (SlMode=Pips with TpMode=Pips and RRR): slPips/tpPips are byte-for-byte identical to pre-change code and OnTick returns before any close, confirming purely-additive behavior. cAlgo API MEMBERS TO CONFIRM ON COMPILE: OnTick() override signature; Positions collection + Position.Label; Position.NetProfit (assumed account/deposit currency net incl. commission+swap); Position.Close() (ClosePosition(position) noted as the alternative in comments). ExecuteMarketOrder/PlaceLimitOrder nullable-pip overloads were already assumed by pre-existing code (unchanged).
